annotations.title: Turn on email for a domain

description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Turn on GearHost email for a custom domain in the user's account (e.g. mycoffeeshop.com), so it can have mailboxes like hello@mycoffeeshop.com. The domain must already be in the account (attach_custom_domain adds one to a site); gearhost.io addresses cannot have email. When the domain's DNS is managed at GearHost (or a Cloudflare zone the user connected), the mail records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) are added automatically; otherwise the result lists the records to add at the DNS host. If email costs extra on the site's plan, the first call changes nothing and returns needs_confirmation with the monthly charges; tell the user the charge and call again with accept_charges:true ONLY after they agree. Then use create_mailbox. Returns structuredContent { status, domain, dns:{ applied, records:[{type,name,content,priority}] }, settings:{ incoming, outgoing } }.

accept_charges.description: Set true only after the user agreed to the monthly charge a previous call returned.

domain.description: The custom domain to receive email, e.g. "mycoffeeshop.com".

name: enable_email

charges.description: Present with needs_confirmation: monthly USD amounts.

settings.description: Mail client settings for every mailbox on the domain.
